section1.content: We collect personal data that you voluntarily provide, including your email address when creating an account or purchasing access. We do not use advertising trackers. Vercel automatically collects your IP address and location to ensure the service functions properly.

section2.title: 2. Use of Data
section2.content: Your data is used to: send your access link via email, ensure the service operates properly, and contact you if needed for technical support. We never sell your data to third parties.

section3.title: 3. Security
section3.content: Your data is securely stored in our SQLite database. Payments are processed 100% securely by Stripe, and we never have access to banking information.

section4.title: 4. GDPR & Privacy Rights
section4.content: You have the right to access, modify, or delete your personal data. Contact us at designmoiunmouton@gmail.com to exercise your rights.
